method: Equal-weight mean of six categories, rounded to one decimal.

identity_and_footprint.finding: GIS FID 227 and archive identity support the model; bounds closely track footprint but GIS is not survey control.

placement_and_orientation.finding: R8 read-only master check shows expected relative library path, transform within 0.02 m, zero rotation and unit scale; R10 does not alter placement.

roof_and_height.finding: R10 2018 DSM-DTM p50/p90/p95 are 36.92/40.25/40.43 m; modeled shell slab is 33.2-33.4 m and coping top 36.5 m. Conflict is documented but does not locate which component is wrong.

exterior_and_texturing.finding: Brick and repeated openings render coherently; broad blank elevations remain and available photo lacks registered direction and calibrated color.

interior_and_circulation.finding: Third-floor render and 2022 plan correspond at broad zone/core level; current partitions, routes and furniture remain schematic and vertical continuity unverified.

technical_integrity_and_evidence.finding: Blender 5.2.3 reopen validation passes with expected counts/bounds, provenance, no unpacked images, and no shared/master edits; R10 records source/method/uncertainty.

primary_deductions: Modeled roof slab is approximately 3.5 m below the R10 lidar median surface, and the source cannot assign that discrepancy to a specific component.
Large blank facade faces remain unverified and no registered facade source supports additional openings.
Interior room/circulation geometry and complete vertical continuity remain schematic or unverified.
